methods.add.confirm_body: The passkey is made. Use it once more so that Ferret can check that it gives the same key every time. Nothing is saved before that.
methods.add.explain_create: Your browser will ask you to create a passkey for this vault and to prove that it is you, with a fingerprint, a face, a PIN or a phone. The passkey is tied to this web address only.
methods.add.heading: Add a passkey
methods.add.leftover: Nothing was added to your vault. The passkey that was just made is still in your passkey provider; delete it there if you do not want it.
methods.add.limit: The account has {max} passkeys, which is the most. Remove one to add another.
methods.add.name_help: A name that tells you which passkey this is, for example “Laptop” or “Phone”. 1 to 64 characters. Only you can read it: it is kept inside your encrypted vault.
methods.add.waiting_create: Your browser asks for the passkey now. Follow its prompt.
methods.blocked.mac: On a Mac, a passkey provider has to be turned on first: System Settings › General › AutoFill & Passwords, for example the Passwords app.
methods.blocked.other_manager: Another password manager may have taken over the passkeys of this browser. Turn its passkey support off for this site, or choose this browser or your system when it asks where to save the passkey.
methods.blocked.windows: On Windows, Windows Hello has to be set up (Settings › Accounts › Sign-in options). Without it Windows asks for a security key.
methods.error.bad_request: The server did not accept the change. Nothing was changed.
methods.error.conflict: This passkey, or a method with this id, is already on the list. Nothing was changed.
methods.error.method_name_bad_character: The name has a character that cannot be used (a control or invisible character). No passkey was made.
methods.error.method_name_empty: Give the passkey a name. No passkey was made.
methods.error.method_name_too_long: The name is too long: {limit} characters at the most. No passkey was made.
methods.error.method_not_found: That method is no longer on the list. Nothing was changed.
methods.error.method_unconfirmed: The server's answer did not arrive in a form this page can trust, so the change may or may not be in force. Look at the list below, and try again if it is not.
methods.error.not_a_passkey: Only a passkey can be removed here. The master password and the recovery key have pages of their own.
methods.error.not_found: That method is no longer on the list. Nothing was changed.
methods.error.passkey_bad_answer: The answer of the browser was not what this page asked for. Nothing was changed.
methods.error.passkey_bad_output: The passkey answered with a key of the wrong size. Nothing was changed.
methods.error.passkey_blocked: The browser refused at once, before it asked you anything. Nothing was changed. Check the following and try again.
methods.error.passkey_cancelled: The passkey prompt was closed or ran out of time. Nothing was changed. You can try again.
methods.error.passkey_exists: This passkey is already one of the unlock methods. Use another passkey.
methods.error.passkey_failed: The passkey could not be made. Nothing was changed.
methods.error.passkey_no_output: The passkey gave no key the second time. Nothing was changed.
methods.error.passkey_no_prf: This passkey cannot make a key for the vault (it does not support the PRF extension). Try another one, for example Windows Hello, Touch ID or a phone. Nothing was changed.
methods.error.passkey_not_verified: The passkey did not check who is using it (a PIN, a fingerprint or a face). A passkey without that check cannot unlock the vault. Nothing was changed.
methods.error.passkey_other_credential: The browser used another passkey than the one that was just made. Nothing was changed.
methods.error.passkey_security: The browser refused to make a passkey for this web address. The vault has to be opened over https with its host name, not with an IP address.
methods.error.passkey_sequence: That step is not possible now. Start again.
methods.error.passkey_stored_here: This passkey is stored in Ferret itself, so it cannot unlock the vault it lives in. Use a passkey from your system, your phone or a security key. Nothing was changed.
methods.error.passkey_unstable: The passkey gave a different key the second time, so it could not open the vault reliably. Nothing was changed. The passkey that was just made can be deleted from your passkey provider.
methods.error.passkey_unsupported: This browser or system cannot make a passkey for this use. Nothing was changed.
methods.error.quota_exceeded: The account has {max} passkeys, which is the most. Remove one first.
methods.error.too_many_passkeys: The account has {max} passkeys, which is the most. Remove one first.
methods.error.unsupported_envelope: The server could not store the change. Nothing was changed.
methods.error.write_conflict: The unlock methods changed while you were working. Nothing was changed. Try again.
methods.heading: Unlock methods
methods.intro: A passkey opens your vault in place of the master password: Windows Hello, Touch ID, a phone, or a security key that works with this vault. Add or remove them here.
methods.list.empty: No passkey unlocks this vault yet.
methods.list.heading: Your passkeys
methods.remove.body: “{name}” stops opening your vault, on every device, from the next time you unlock it. The passkey itself stays in Windows, iCloud, your phone or wherever it is kept: delete it there as well.
methods.remove.done: “{name}” was removed from the unlock methods. Delete the passkey from your passkey provider as well.
methods.remove.label: Remove {name}
methods.remove.title: Remove “{name}”?
methods.title: Unlock methods
methods.unavailable: This server does not offer passkeys as unlock methods.
methods.what.heading: What a passkey does and does not do
methods.what.host: A passkey is tied to the exact host name of this vault ({site}). If the vault moves to another host name, the passkeys stop working and have to be added again.
methods.what.no_password: A passkey opens the vault without the master password and without the secret key. Anyone who can use the passkey, and pass its check (a PIN, a fingerprint or a face), can open your vault.
methods.what.remove: Removing a passkey here stops it from opening the vault, on every device. The key itself stays in Windows, iCloud or your phone: delete it there too.
methods.what.still: Your master password and your recovery key still work. A passkey is another way in, not a replacement.
methods.what.suspect: If you suspect this web vault or the server it comes from, remove the passkeys you added here.
methods.what.synced: A synced passkey (kept in iCloud Keychain, a Google account or a similar service) is as safe as the cloud account it lives in. A passkey marked “This device only” does not leave the device that made it.
